title: SshServersUpdate
description: The servers a live session may use changed (a server added, removed or renamed in the project, a role grant changed). The daemon rewrites the session's ssh_config atomically and drops its current certificate (the next use asks for a new one). Also sent once per live session after a node reconnects. version grows per session; an older version than the last applied is ignored. An empty servers list: the session has no server any more (remove ssh_config).
